title: PipelineTopology
description: Defines the ordered sequence of workers and their contracts.

worker.description: Worker name (e.g. intake, understand, generate, evaluate, publish).

input_schema.description: Relative path to the JSON schema for this worker's input.

output_schema.description: Relative path to the JSON schema for this worker's output.

checkpoint.description: Whether to persist output as a checkpoint for resumability.

optional.description: Whether the worker can be skipped without failing the pipeline.

re_run_targets.description: List of worker names that can be re-run to fix issues found by this worker.

max_re_runs.description: Maximum number of re-run cycles allowed.

requires_verdict.description: If set, this worker only runs when the named worker's verdict matches.

defaults.description: Default values applied to all workers unless overridden.
